title: Quaestiones Hebraicae in libros Regum et Paralipomenon
author: Pseudo-Hieronymus / Auctor incertus (Hieronymus Stridonensis?)
source: Translated by Claude from tmp458.tmp458.opp-lat1, as held by Open Greek and Latin's Patrologia Latina.

passages.original: Tradunt Hebraei in hoc loco illos vocari eunuchos, qui, ab omnibus actibus saeculi alieni, orationi tantum et lectioni vacabant : et uxores non causa libidinis, sed suscipiendae prolis gratia habebant, quos Josephus secundum eorum haeresim Essenos b vocat.
passages.english: The Hebrews hand down that in this passage those men are called eunuchs who, being strangers to all the activities of the world, devoted themselves only to prayer and reading, and had wives not for the sake of lust but for the sake of begetting offspring; Josephus calls them Essenes, according to their sect.
passages.notes: The 'b' after 'Essenos' is a footnote mark from the printed edition and has been omitted. 'secundum eorum haeresim' is rendered 'according to their sect': haeresis here means a school or party, not 'heresy'.
